topic: How do MPLS and IPsec VPNs differ in mitigating congestion for real-time QoS in multi-telectric utility backbones?
consensus_response: MPLS and IPsec VPNs differ in congestion mitigation. MPLS provides enhanced scalability, prioritizing traffic aggregates through label switching, ensuring mission-critical traffic receives preferential treatment. In contrast, IPsec focuses on secure communication, introducing latency and jitter, affecting QoS guarantees.
reference_context: MPLS and IPsec VPNs have unique strengths, with MPLS optimizing capacity and IPsec focusing on security, impacting performance and QoS.
